python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
cards=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(cards)==len(answers)
assert [c['card_id'] for c in cards]==[a['card_id'] for a in answers]
assert len({a['card_id'] for a in answers})==len(answers)
required={'card_id','letters','marks','crop_ok','errors','detail','owner_crop','where'}
owner={'one_central_line','text_ne_visible_line','other_complete_line','gt2_whole_neighbour_words','turned_or_clipped'}
for a in answers:
 assert required<=a.keys()
 assert a['letters'] in ['y','n','u'] and a['marks'] in ['y','n','na'] and a['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert set(a['owner_crop'])==owner and set(a['owner_crop'].values())<={'yes','no','uncertain'}
 assert all(set(w)=={'label','printed'} for w in a['where'])
print('Count and order verified:',len(answers))
for field in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(field,dict(collections.Counter(a[field] for a in answers)))
print('Error types:',collections.Counter(e for a in answers for e in a['errors']).most_common())
